product.title: Canvas Laundry Bag for Home & Toy Storage – Collapsible | Organivo
product.body_html:
Transform your home organisation with the versatile and stylish Canvas Laundry Bag from Organivo. Designed specifically for the dynamic needs of Indian households, this robust yet lightweight storage solution is your perfect partner for keeping spaces clutter-free. Whether it's managing dirty clothes, tidying up children's toys, or simply needing an extra storage bin, this high-capacity, collapsible laundry hamper offers both functionality and a touch of modern elegance. Say goodbye to messy rooms and welcome a more organised, serene living environment with this essential home accessory.

Our premium canvas laundry bag stands out with its thoughtful design and durable construction. Crafted to withstand daily use, it's not just a utility item but a piece that complements your home decor. The waterproof interior ensures hygiene and easy cleaning, making it a practical choice for any family. Its ability to fold flat means it’s perfect for smaller apartments or when you need to store it away discreetly. Experience the blend of quality, convenience, and style that only a 'Made in India' product like this can offer.

Key features

  • Durable Canvas Construction: Crafted from high-quality, resilient canvas fabric, ensuring exceptional durability and long-term use for all your storage needs.
  • 100% Waterproof Interior: Features a robust waterproof lining, making it perfectly suitable for damp laundry and incredibly easy to clean with just a simple wipe.
  • Collapsible & Space-Saving Design: Engineered to fold completely flat when not in use, offering an intelligent and efficient storage solution for homes with limited space.
  • Sturdy & Shape-Retaining Structure: Reinforced with sturdy rings at both the top and bottom, ensuring the bag maintains its upright, cylindrical shape even when empty or partially filled.
  • Ample 45 Litre Capacity: Boasts a generous 45-litre volume, providing substantial space to hold a significant amount of laundry, children's toys, or other household items, ideal for families.
  • Multipurpose Home Storage: Exceptionally versatile, serving effectively as a dedicated laundry basket, a convenient toy storage bag, or for general organisation of various household articles.
  • Proudly Made in India: Manufactured with pride in India, supporting local craftsmanship and guaranteeing a product built with meticulous attention to quality and detail.
  • Stylish & Modern Aesthetic: Presents a contemporary and appealing design that effortlessly enhances your home decor, proving that utility can also be fashionable.

Materials & care

This Organivo canvas laundry bag is constructed from a high-grade, durable canvas fabric, complemented by a 100% waterproof interior lining. To maintain its pristine condition and extend its lifespan, simply wipe down both the interior and exterior surfaces with a damp cloth. Avoid using harsh chemical cleaners or abrasive scrubbing, and do not machine wash, as this could compromise the waterproof lining and fabric integrity. Allow it to air dry thoroughly after cleaning.

FAQ

Is this laundry bag suitable for heavy loads?
Yes, despite its lightweight nature, our canvas laundry bag is engineered with a sturdy canvas construction and reinforced rings at the top and bottom, allowing it to comfortably handle heavy loads of laundry or a substantial quantity of toys without collapsing or losing its shape.
Can I use this for toy storage in a child's room?
Absolutely! With its generous 45-litre capacity and durable yet soft canvas material, it makes an excellent and stylish solution for storing children's toys, blankets, stuffed animals, or other playroom essentials. It's also easy for kids to use.
How do I clean the laundry bag?
Thanks to its 100% waterproof interior lining, cleaning is hassle-free. Simply wipe down the inside and outside surfaces with a damp cloth. For best results, let it air dry completely before its next use.
What are the exact dimensions of this Organivo laundry bag?
The laundry bag measures approximately 37 cm in diameter and 45 cm in height. This provides a substantial storage volume while ensuring it fits conveniently into most home spaces, from bedrooms to utility areas.
Is this product truly 'Made in India'?
Yes, we are proud to confirm that this canvas laundry bag is entirely 'Made in India', supporting local manufacturing and ensuring a product crafted with quality and care.
